verses.text: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
lines: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous!
Praise is fitting for the upright.

verses.text: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
lines: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre.
Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

verses.text: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
lines: Sing to him a new song.
Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

verses.text: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
lines: For Yahweh’s word is right.
All his work is done in faithfulness.

verses.text: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
lines: He loves righteousness and justice.
The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

verses.text: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
lines: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made:
all their army by the breath of his mouth.

verses.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
lines: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap.
He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

verses.text: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
lines: Let all the earth fear Yahweh.
Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.text: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
lines: For he spoke, and it was done.
He commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.text: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
lines: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing.
He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

verses.text: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
lines: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever,
the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
lines: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh,
the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.text: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
lines: Yahweh looks from heaven.
He sees all the sons of men.

verses.text: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
lines: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

verses.text: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
lines: he who fashions all of their hearts;
and he considers all of their works.

verses.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
lines: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army.
A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

verses.text: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
lines: A horse is a vain thing for safety,
neither does he deliver any by his great power.

verses.text: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
lines: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him,
on those who hope in his loving kindness,

verses.text: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
lines: to deliver their soul from death,
to keep them alive in famine.

verses.text: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
lines: Our soul has waited for Yahweh.
He is our help and our shield.

verses.text: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
lines: For our heart rejoices in him,
because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.text: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
lines: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh,
since we have hoped in you.
